name: Classic Helm charts
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Set HELM_CONFIG_HOME, HELM_CACHE_HOME and HELM_DATA_HOME to new directories; pull into an empty working directory.
prerequisites: An existing Helm repository; a chart directory acme/ with Chart.yaml.
For signed charts, retain the signing public keyring for helm pull --verify.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export HELM_CONFIG_HOME="$AW_WORK/config"
export HELM_CACHE_HOME="$AW_WORK/cache"
export HELM_DATA_HOME="$AW_WORK/data"
export HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/config/registry/config.json"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/config/registry"
configure.note: Use a fresh configuration and cache for every independent connection check.

configure.code:
helm repo add aw "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/helm/$AW_REPO" --username "$AW_USER" --password "$AW_TOKEN"
helm repo update aw

publish.note: Classic Helm publication uploads the packaged chart; the server derives index.yaml. Upload a .prov file alongside its chart when signed.

install.note: The repository alias aw refers to the selected local, remote, virtual or federated repository.

steps.code:
helm search repo aw/acme --versions
helm pull aw/acme --version 0.1.0 --destination "$AW_WORK/pulled"

limitations: Do not upload a handcrafted index.yaml: the server builds the native index from stored archives.
Classic Helm and Helm OCI use different endpoints and commands.
No --pass-credentials is used; credentials must not be forwarded to unrelated download hosts.
